title: Continuous compactly supported L¹(ν)-approximation of a covector field keeping |·|_E ≤ 1 and support in O
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, ν a finite measure on ℝ^P, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ O compact, and g : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n ν-integrable (Bochner integrable for the operator norm) with |g(x)|_E ≤ 1 for all x and g(x) = 0 for all x ∉ K (|·|_E = covectorEuclideanNorm). Then for every ε > 0 there is a continuous f : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n with compact support, tsupport f ⊆ O, |f(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z, and ∫⁻ ofReal(|f(x) − g(x)|_E) dν(x) ≤ ofReal(ε).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → Integrable g ν → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → g x = 0) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ f : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ tsupport f ⊆ O ∧ (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (f z) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (f x - g x)) ∂ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
